seo.title: Tcherassi Hotel + Spa: Design Boutique Cartagena Honeymoon Review (2026)
seo.description: 5-star design-led boutique hotel in Cartagena's Old Town by Silvia Tcherassi. Score 92/100, from $450/night. Honest 2026 verdict, best suite, itinerary, real cost & email.

content.verdict: Tcherassi Hotel + Spa is the fashion-house honeymoon move in Cartagena — a 250-year-old colonial mansion on Calle del Sargento Mayor, restored and reimagined by Colombian fashion designer Silvia Tcherassi (the Milan-based designer whose work shows in international fashion weeks) into a seven-key design hotel where every detail is a Tcherassi decision. The result is the most architecturally interesting hotel in Cartagena: a vertical garden that climbs three stories of an interior wall, plunge pools cantilevered between colonial columns, a rooftop pool deck on the highest open terrace in the Old Town, and rooms styled like couture suites with Italian linens, Diptyque amenities, and Colombian artisan textiles layered through. With only seven keys, the entire hotel can feel like a private residence rented for the week. The spa — Silvia's own line of treatments — is one of the best in the city, smaller and more intimate than Sofitel's but with a more curated treatment menu. Vera Restaurant on the ground floor (Italian, by chef Alessandro Pacini) is consistently among Cartagena's top tables. Couples who care about design, who want a hotel that looks as good on Instagram as it feels in person, and who prefer seven-key intimacy to thirty-key boutique, should book Tcherassi over every other property in the city.
content.best_room: The Master Suite is the obvious target — a full-floor 800-square-foot suite with a king bed, a private terrace, and Tcherassi's most layered interior styling. For couples who specifically want a private plunge pool, the Pool Suite is unique to Tcherassi in Cartagena — a one-bedroom suite with a cantilevered plunge pool spilling into the colonial courtyard below. Avoid the Junior Tcherassi rooms only if you can stretch the budget; even the entry-level rooms are beautifully designed.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Arrival into the design house
itinerary_7_nights.description: Fly into CTG, transfer to Tcherassi (15 minutes). Welcome cocktail on the vertical-garden mezzanine. Settle in, swim in the rooftop pool, and have dinner at Vera (the Italian restaurant on the ground floor, with one of the city's best wine lists).

itinerary_7_nights.title: Old Town walking and Tcherassi spa
itinerary_7_nights.description: Morning walking tour with concierge-arranged guide — Plaza San Diego, Plaza Santo Domingo, the cathedral. Lunch at Carmen on Calle del Santísimo. Afternoon at the Tcherassi spa for the signature couples treatment (the cacao-and-honey ritual is the move). Dinner at La Vitrola for live Cuban music.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Rosario Islands day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Hotel-arranged private boat to Rosario Islands — 45 minutes to Blue Apple Beach or Bora Bora Beach Club. Snorkeling, grilled fish lunch, return by 5pm. Sundown drinks at Alquímico rooftop (a five-minute walk from Tcherassi).

itinerary_7_nights.title: Getsemaní street art and salsa
itinerary_7_nights.description: Lazy morning at the rooftop pool. Late-afternoon walk into Getsemaní for the street art murals, Plaza Trinidad, and dinner at Celele or Demente. Salsa lesson and dancing at Café Havana into the night.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Coffee, chocolate, sunset on the walls
itinerary_7_nights.description: Colombian coffee cupping at one of the small Old Town cafés (Abaco or Café del Reloj). ChocoMuseo bean-to-bar class at 4pm. Sunset cocktails at Café del Mar on the walls, then dinner back at Vera or a walkable booking at Don Juan.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Volcán del Totumo, romantic dinner
itinerary_7_nights.description: Morning trip to Volcán del Totumo for the mud bath. Back by 1pm, lazy afternoon at the rooftop pool. Concierge-arranged private dinner table on the rooftop deck — Vera will set it up under candlelight with the chef's personal tasting menu.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Shopping morning, departure
itinerary_7_nights.description: Final morning at the Silvia Tcherassi flagship boutique in Plaza San Diego (right around the corner) — Cartagena's best fashion-buy moment. Light lunch in the courtyard. Transfer to CTG. The hotel is small enough that the entire staff says goodbye by name.

caveats: Seven keys means almost zero availability flexibility — book 4 to 6 months ahead minimum. The Master Suite and Pool Suite sell out 9+ months in advance for peak season.
Tcherassi has no large public restaurant beyond Vera; couples wanting variety should plan to eat out most evenings (Cartagena has the restaurants for it).
The rooftop pool is small (it serves seven rooms, after all). Couples wanting a substantial pool deck should look at Casa San Agustin or Sofitel Santa Clara instead.

faqs.question: Good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: Excellent — the design-led aesthetic, seven-key intimacy, Tcherassi spa, and rooftop pool deliver exactly the boutique honeymoon experience couples want from Cartagena. Couples and design-led travelers represent the vast majority of guests.

faqs.question: Best time to visit?
faqs.answer: January through March for the photographic peak. December and April are also dry and lovely. Tcherassi runs noticeable discounts in May-June and October-November shoulder seasons.

faqs.question: Book in advance?
faqs.answer: With only seven keys, Tcherassi books fastest in Cartagena. Master Suite and Pool Suite need 9+ months for peak; standard rooms 4 to 6 months. Reach out directly through the hotel for honeymoon package add-ons (private rooftop dinner, spa credit, in-room turn-down).

faqs.question: Adults-only?
faqs.answer: Not officially, but the seven-key boutique scale, design focus, and price point mean children are extremely rare. The hotel functions as an adult-couples property in practice.

faqs.question: Best room type?
faqs.answer: Master Suite for the full Tcherassi experience. Pool Suite if you specifically want a private plunge pool spilling into the courtyard. Junior Tcherassi for value while still keeping the design aesthetic.

faqs.question: How to get there?
faqs.answer: CTG airport is 15 minutes from the Old Town. Tcherassi arranges private transfers ($40-50). The hotel sits on Calle del Sargento Mayor, a quiet residential street just off Plaza San Diego — central but tucked away.
